# Guards without a production caller and without a justified module-level
# WIRING exemption. The gate measures this count; do not raise it to accept a
# new unreachable guard.
#
# Current exemptions are explicit and feature-scoped:
#
# - src/ai/execution/blind_compute.rs: IP-60 T-Expansion waits for IP-56 and
#   activation after M7.
# - src/ai_inference/verify.rs: helper/scaffold proof format is not the
#   transaction verifier. The module documents serialization, program-hash,
#   and public-input mismatches; tests lock out production callers.
# - src/consensus/zk_verifier.rs: the ZK QC fault-proof path stays fail-closed
#   until BudZero STARK verification is integrated.
# - src/light_client/mod.rs: IP-60 remote-state verification is not consumed
#   by a production transition before its post-M7 activation.
# - src/storage/server_admission.rs: legacy B.U.D. 1.0 admission is excluded
#   pending IP-07 removal; B.U.D. 3.0 manifest deals own active routing.
#
# Any change to these reasons must be backed by the feature matrix and tests.
